scholarships.title: Clinical Fellowship 2027 — European Academy of Neurology

existing.description: The EAN Clinical Fellowship funds a clinical observational placement of six to twelve weeks at an approved EAN host neurological department outside the applicant's country of residence, at EUR 425 per week plus up to EUR 300 of travel costs reimbursed after the fellowship. The programme is designed for neurologists who are still training or have recently qualified, and the total annual budget supports 300 fellowship weeks. Applications for the 2027 round are open from 1 August to 31 October 2026, and results are communicated by the end of December 2026. Active EAN RRFS or Full membership is a condition of applying, and only approved host departments on the published 2027/2028 list may be used.
eligibility: Minimum two years of clinical (residency) training in neurology at the time of the fellowship
RRFS member working in an EAN Full Institutional Member country, or in a Corresponding Institutional Member country or a low and lower-middle income country in sub-Saharan Africa
Full member working in an EAN Full Institutional Member or Corresponding Institutional Member country, up to a maximum of 5 years after the latest degree in neurology
Be fluent in English or in the local language of the hosting country
Have been accepted by an approved EAN host department listed for 2027/2028
Must hold an active EAN RRFS or Full membership at the time of application
Not based in a country other than the host country, as the stay must be outside the country of residence
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants need at least two years of clinical residency training in neurology, an active EAN RRFS or Full membership, institutional affiliation in an EAN Full or Corresponding Institutional Member country or in a low or lower-middle income sub-Saharan African country, fluency in English or the host country's language, and acceptance by an approved EAN host department outside their country of residence.
benefits: EUR 425 per week, with a total of 300 fellowship weeks funded each year
Clinical observational experience in a department with recognised expertise
Optional buddy programme with a resident at the host department
Free EAN RRFS membership for the buddy in the year following the stay
coverage: EUR 425 per week for the length of the stay, 6 to 12 weeks
Travel costs up to a maximum of EUR 300 for the trip to the host department and back home
Buddy programme support at the host department
requirements: Active EAN RRFS or Full membership, applied for at least three weeks before the deadline because approval can take up to 10 working days
Accepted by a host department on the approved 2027/2028 list
Stay of 6 to 12 weeks, at least 5 days per week
Two letters of recommendation from individual neurologists
Evidence of training of at least two years of clinical experience in neurology
documents: Application form, visible only to logged-in EAN members between 1 August and 31 October 2026, including a declaration of eligibility
Acceptance by host department form, with a supervisor expected to have at least weekly direct contact
Confirmation of current length of neurology training plus a declaration of the hospital where training took place
Two letters of recommendation from two individual neurologists
application_method: Online application via the EAN application hub at my.ean.org; the registration link is visible only to EAN members
Applicants and hosts are expected to have consulted and worked together before submitting
existing.selection_notes: Each application is reviewed by two members of the EAN Education Committee with final approval by the Education Committee Chair, using a scoring sheet combining a score for the application, a score for the CV and a score for the overall impression. Applicants are asked to explain the gains expected from the fellowship in the context of their usual practice, which EAN states is a major factor in the rating. At most 10%, and no more than two per country, of accepted applicants may come from Corresponding Institutional Member countries or low and lower-middle income sub-Saharan African countries.
existing.best_fit: Neurologists in residency or recently qualified, with at least two years of clinical neurology training and an EAN RRFS or Full membership, who want a six to twelve week observational placement at an approved European host department outside their own country.
existing.notes: Travel costs are reimbursed only after the fellowship ends, on receipt of the final report, a confirmation from the host mentor and the evaluation forms. From 2027 one grant of nine weeks is reserved for members working in EAN Full or Corresponding Institutional Member countries, defined as low, lower-middle and upper-middle income countries, funded by an endowed fellowship from Prof. Abhijit Chaudhuri's family. Five additional fellowships are available to RRFS members from Ukraine. The grant should ideally be used by a fellow who knows the language of the host department, because not all patient rounds can be held in English.
existing.duration: Minimum 6 weeks, maximum 12 weeks, at a minimum of 5 days per week

scholarships.title: Research Fellowship 2027 — European Academy of Neurology

existing.description: The EAN Research Fellowship supports European neurologists to carry out research at an academic neurological department outside their country of residence, at EUR 2,000 per month plus up to EUR 500 of travel costs reimbursed after the fellowship. It runs two tracks: Research Training Fellowships of typically 12 months and no less than six months, and Research Experience Fellowships of typically six months and no less than three months. The annual budget covers 72 fellowship months, usually four to five training and two to three experience awards. Applications for 2027 ran from 1 June to 31 August 2026 and are now closed, with results due by the end of November 2026.
eligibility: Active EAN RRFS or Full membership; approval can take up to 10 working days, so membership should be applied for at least three weeks before the deadline
Affiliated with a European academic neurological department
RRFS member working in an EAN Full Institutional Member country with more than two years of clinical neurology training at the time of the event
Full member working in an EAN Full Institutional Member country, up to a maximum of five years after the latest degree in neurology
Fluent in English or in the local language of the hosting country
Research work must be carried out at a European academic neurological department outside the applicant's country of residence
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold an active EAN RRFS or Full membership, be affiliated with a European academic neurological department, be fluent in English or the host country's language, and be either an RRFS member with more than two years of neurology residency in an EAN Full Institutional Member country or a Full member in such a country within five years of their latest neurology degree.
benefits: Placement at a European academic neurological department outside the applicant's country
Access to research training that the applicant cannot obtain at home
coverage: EUR 2,000 per month for the duration of the fellowship
Travel expenses of up to EUR 500 for the trip to and from the host department
requirements: Active EAN RRFS or Full membership
Acceptance letter from the chair of the host institution, including a short CV and short bibliography for the proposed mentor
Recommendation from the chair of the home department and a second recommendation from another neurologist
Full project description with background, aims, methods, timetable and references
documents: EAN CV form including a list of publications
Copy of a document confirming neurology training and its duration, in English
Project description with background, aims, methods, timetable and references
Recommendation form from the chair of the home department
Letter of acceptance from the chair of the host institution with a short mentor CV and bibliography
application_method: All application documents must be submitted through the EAN online application form; hand-written applications and e-mail submissions are not accepted
Original documents or fresh copies may be requested after submission and must be retained until the outcome is notified
existing.selection_notes: Each application is reviewed by two experts drawn from the EAN Scientific Panels and one Education Committee member, with results communicated by the end of November 2026. The public scoring sheet applies nine separate scores: four for the project (originality, feasibility, usefulness for career, methods), two for the candidate (CV, publications), two for the proposed host (department, supervisor) and one for the overall impression. Feasibility, methods, host department, own CV and overall impression carry more weight than the other components.
existing.best_fit: European neurologists with an EAN RRFS or Full membership who want three to twelve months of research experience at an academic neurological department in another European country.
existing.notes: Travel costs are reimbursed only after the fellowship ends, against the fellow's final report and the evaluation forms from both the fellow and the host mentor. Successful fellowships may be applied retroactively from 1 September 2026 where the stay started earlier. Previous awardees receive no preference.
existing.duration: Research Training Fellowship: typically 12 months, minimum 6. Research Experience Fellowship: typically 6 months, minimum 3
existing.deadline_display: 31 August (annual close; the 2027 window ran 1 June - 31 August 2026)
